game.title: Uncharted 3: Drake's Deception
game.blurb: Cinematic third-person action-adventure in which Nathan Drake and his mentor Victor Sullivan search for a lost city, from Naughty Dog, released 2011-11-01 on PlayStation 3 (later PlayStation 4). RAWG average playtime: 12 hours. Genre: Action. Chapters are an estimate drawn from the chapter page names in the StrategyWiki contents (no Steam achievement list).

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has a page at completion stage 1, but only 2 of its 22 walkthrough chapter pages are written ("Another Round" and "Greatness from Small Beginnings"), plus Treasures, Trophies and the contents page, so it was not used for text. The seven chapters here group its 22 chapter page names in contents order; titles are reworded. uncharted.fandom.com answers the API, with about 48 linked pages (including co-op modes and map packs); names only were looked at, nothing copied. RAWG's first result is the expected entry (5703); RAWG lists PlayStation 3 and PlayStation 4 only. No Steam app, so there are no achievements.
